/**
 * Represents the JavaScript object/struct "Recommendations".
 */
@DoNotStrip
@Keep
data class Recommendations(
  @DoNotStrip
  @Keep
  val data: Array<SearchResultItem>,
  @DoNotStrip
  @Keep
  val pager: SearchResultsPager,
  @DoNotStrip
  @Keep
  val version: ApiVersionValue
) {
  /* primary constructor */

  override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
    if (this === other) return true
    if (other !is Recommendations) return false
    return Objects.deepEquals(this.data, other.data)
      && Objects.deepEquals(this.pager, other.pager)
      && Objects.deepEquals(this.version, other.version)
  }

  override fun hashCode(): Int {
    return arrayOf<Any?>(
      data,
      pager,
      version
    ).contentDeepHashCode()
  }

  companion object {
    /**
     * Constructor called from C++
     */
    @DoNotStrip
    @Keep
    @Suppress("unused")
    @JvmStatic
    private fun fromCpp(data: Array<SearchResultItem>, pager: SearchResultsPager, version: ApiVersionValue): Recommendations {
      return Recommendations(data, pager, version)
    }
  }
}
